skills.name: bvkit-oneclick-charts
skills.entry_style: 按图表意图（kind）调用；chapter 仅作内部溯源与精确复刻入口

layout.depth_limit: root/<dir>/<file> only — the market parser rejects deeper nesting
layout.flat: python modules flattened into scripts/ (entry scripts/cli.py), specs and csv flattened into references/
layout.note: bvkit/ 与 examples/ 不在 WorkBuddy 白名单，且三级目录会被判「目录层级超限」，故平铺

submitted.review_window: 7 个工作日（实际当日通过）
